description: This file defines the IGrainDirectory interface for grain directory implementations in Orleans, including methods for registering, unregistering, and looking up grain addresses, as well as an extension method for registration logic.

classes.name: GrainDirectoryExtension
classes.description: Contains extension methods for IGrainDirectory, specifically a Register method that handles unregistering previous addresses before registering a new one.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Extension method for IGrainDirectory that unregisters a previous address if provided, then registers a new address.
